children: said in an SEC filing on Tuesday that it has expanded its strategic partnership with Binance related to the promotion of USDC

As part of the agreement, Circle will pay Binance a monthly incentive fee representing a percentage of the amount of USDC held through the Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure service. Binance is set to take certain other activities to promote USDC on its platform.
The arrangement is subject to a term of five years.
Additionally, Circle has sold to Binance about 1.24M class A shares at a discounted price of $80.84 per share for aggregate proceeds of $100M. The subscribed shares were sold in a private placement.
CRCL was trading 2.01% higher at $96.39 during pre-market trading.

title: Circle Internet, Binance expand USDC promotion ties; Circle sells $100M class A shares to Binance
